author: Jordan Peters
content:
It is talked about , a lot . I mention it every time that you don’t do more volume than you need . So yes more volume = more stimulus but when you are small you don’t need it .
Imagine this , you are a circle that is 2cm in diameter , 3 sets colours in tbe circle fully . That’s you maxed out . More sets now goes outside the circle and doesn’t make YOU grow more as YOU don’t need it .
Let’s say Marc is a 6cm circle , he needs 6 sets to fully max that stimulus.
So as a result of the 6 sets mark does he trades off some frequency for volume . But the key is not much , he would move from 3 sleeps to 4 sleeps
So as I say over and over and over , focus on frequency . ( and the reason is because YOU don’t need more volume )

The downside is it raises progesterone , which then interacts with estro and then can cause gyno a lot easier , as despite systemic e2 levels being lower , the progesterone e2 interaction ramps up receptor activity at the chest a lot! This isn’t an issue for me but is for many
It has a stronger mg for mg ability to build muscle due to its increased nitrogen retention ability , its androgenic levels are much lower so its anabolic leveks are higher so everything happening from its effects are greater at the muscle vs the whole body .
It causes increases in local igf levels
It increases collagen synthesis
So if you don’t take it , you miss all those things , if you do , you get what nandrolone does , hence the addition . How j then slide it up or down is based on water retention

The bigger question is why are you needing to do that ? That’s indicative of poor GH timing if anything as you want to keep that away from carbs as best you can even if using at the workout perimeter, as GH stays elevated for 3-4 hours so if your using the wo perimeters glut 4 to overcome impeding glucose uptake , it can still be done at a point that is the furthest from carbs possible , and then insulin is with the carbs…….

author: Jordan Peters
content:
Gh impedes glucose uptake , that’s why it’s better before bed as there is no eating occurring while gh is elevated .
Elevated GH while eating , causes decreasing in insulin sensitivity, as over time the body has to increase insulin output to overcome the impeding the GH is causing .
During a diet phase when in a caloric deficit where insulin sensitivity is superb , am / day time pulses will see increased fat loss and be tolerable due to the deficit ( provided your lean)
But if your not lean / wanting the muscle gain benefits from GH , one bolus dose , pre bed , sub Q , is the best way to administer .

content:
Push today , body feels good !
Just tidying things up a little with the GH into just 2 pulses at the areas that allow for max Insuljn resistance offsetting , pre workout and during the night . The third then being post workout but I’m not using that window atm while using igf .
I’m making these adjusts based on tracking fasted GB and trying tj keep it as low as I can by consolidating / moving around GH , as it’s that which drives IR ( insulin resistance ) up
So fasted BG today 4.3 nmol/l – very good !
No am gh , 12 iu Lantus with meal 1
Pre workout meal will have 6iu fast insulin with jt , 30 mins later , 1 bottle gh ( So my GH are 10-12 iu , some are 10/11/12 , that’s how it goes with Chinese stuff ) .
Start trainjnf and sipping Intra and then 20 ish in , 1.5iu fast .
We know that 12 iu gh is going to impede glucose uptake hard ! Muscle contraction and glut 4 will over ride a lot but defo not all , and that’s where making sure adequate fast is in the vicinity of bolus GH doses .
I’m not sure about the mega doses of insulin Milos advocates . I am unsure if the physiology supports the idea that mega doses will be more anabolic , from my understanding of how those pathways work, it doesn’t , but equally he will of seen something of Merit in it with his guys . So how that looks is you move an even larger proportion of your carbs to the wo perimeter to support insulin of 25iu pre and post . I did thah with him and it works ! But I think it also comes with its own issues and ability to increase visceral fat storage due to rapid declines in IR at those doses . So I’m happy with my 6 and 1.5 for now
Post just igf lr3 , I will check BG here to see if any fast insulin is needed too , if the shake has seen me run high as the GH pre did a job on offsetting that storage and I didn’t quite cover it with enough insulin , I know to take a touch more next time as I want those intra carbs being pulled in and used , them being in the blood is useless!
No more GH rest of day , and then 1 bottle again during the night
That is the cleanest way to run 20ish iu gh a day possible , without a ton of insulin needed which will see IR drive up over time
I plan to run this 12 ish weeks and monitor bG at diff points to assess how far my IR is sliding as it will take more insulin to dk the same job over time when combined with GH
So if you hear someone say, insulin in of itself doesn’t increase IR as diabetics don’t need to up the dose always . Remember the clear counter argument , we are taking the insulin as it’s the GH causing the IR , over time the continued exposure to that GH and insulin will see a decline in IR further and need more insulin . That’s when we re jig again ( go all night time shot ) , while we re gain IS ( insulin sensitivity )
Hope this all helps explain my thinking . I’m not outsourcing this info, it’s all my own from working with Milo’s and then tweaking my own ideas based on understanding IR and IS .
The cool part here is we have reta and the mito stack working hardddd in our favour , so we need less insulin to do the same job which means more GH for longer – WIN!

So gh wise , I was looking back at my emails from Milo’s , which are pretty hilarious because he is/ was so fuckint smart and way ahead of anyone else when it comes to getting legit huge  , but also the period where I gained by FAR the most amount of muscle , like an outrageous amount , it took me from being ok size wise to fucking huge . thread_title: What to do after a cut
author: Jordan Peters
content:
Maintenance isn’t a fixed number , what you’re eating now is your current maintenance to hold your weight . If you add 200 cals now , you will then be in a surplus as your 200 cals over your current maintenance . Once your weight stalls from the 200 cal surplus your then at a new maintenance based on those Cals and that weight .
Add 200-300 cals , wait a couple weeks , add 200 more , wait a couple weeks then 100 cals , wait 3 weeks , then add 100 cals etc
If can’t control the appetite / stick to the above , add retatrutide , 0.5mg / day

thread_title: What is the point in the second set
author: Jordan Peters
content: Weight isn’t relevant , rep ranges aren’t relevant . Failure is . Light weight to failure = maximal muscle fibre recruitment . Doing this more than once = more stimulus . Doing this too many times = recovery demands we don’t need . So the goal is max stimulus with min recovery demands . So this could be 2/3/4 sets depending on your frequency

thread_title: Why Start a Workout with Isolation Exercises Before Compound Movements?
author: Jordan Peters
content: Everything is done in rotation . So when you see people doing this , they have usually exhausted a phase of compound work first and then they do phases of iso work first . Try to stop looking at things in absolute ways . It’s just a rotation / phase , where you target things more accurately . In the same way you may have a phase on one exercise and then a phase on another . One isn’t better than the other , they are just phases as we can’t do the same thing forever

Primo = lowers estro
Eq = lowers estro hard
Mast = doesn’t do either , just masks estro sides
So just balance the sides
If you have a lot of test, you need A LOT of primo , or adex/ aromasin
Less test = less need to control estro
So whatever cycle you pick , just know what each drug does and then balance it accordingly based on side effects
Tons of water = estro too high so slightly lower test / slightly increase primo

thread_title: Understanding structuring of carbs while using a blood glucose monitor.
author: Jordan Peters
content:
No one uses BG for that because it’s not reflective of how we use energy , as hilly said , you can cause a BG reading to spike in a deficit , it means nothing
BG reader is to show us simply how efficient our body is being over time
So your eating normal meals , your BG will do predictable things , when you add growth hormone this changes it and that needs monitoring , or if food gets super high , or both
That’s literally it , it’s there to check that out BG is doing what we expect and when it doesn’t we make an adjustment
Everything you have said , delete from your mind

thread_title: Digest pharma pro- does it actually make a difference to not taking it?
author: Jordan Peters
content:
It’s a digestive enzyme, that is also a patented raw material , I will quickly explain what that means when something is a patented raw. The Ingredients are pharmaceutical grade and made under pharmacy grade conditions , we then sign a trademark licensing agreement with that pharmacy company ( biocore in this instance for digest pharma pro ) , to say that we will include their ingredient at the dose stated . What this means for the consumer is you are absolutely guaranteed the highest quality material on the market . Things that aren’t patented raws have literally no protection over them which means they could be anything at all and your operating off trust . This isn’t about trust , it’s a guarantee
It making a diff , for me, immensely , as I control every variable meticulously. For you , you tell me ? Do you control every variable so you can maximise progress
If you don’t , focusing on sleep and stress will likely impact digestion better than an enzyme

author: Jordan Peters
content:
Bodybuilding is adding contractile tissue that drives a stronger contraction , when the muscle is there , that’s literally then just a case of doing the lift , repeat repeat repeat
What your describing / the guy on IG , is an extremely fast way to max out and stall on a lift as you can’t add contractile Tissue fast enough to support the lift you have performed by going silly with the mental trauma to produce the force . That’s not bodybuilding , that’s not muscular contraction , yes you you can lift more but you haven’t done that because you have adapted by adding more muscle .
I’m not telling you what to do , I literally don’t give a shit what anyone else Does . But I’m telling you that is not bodybuilding which is a fact as you haven’t built more tissue to create contractile force to lift the weight.
So the next question , do you see any Olympian bodybuilders in any class , spazzing out before sets ? No , because if your trying to be a bodybuilder it’s really stupid . The goal is stimulus that is replicable
I have said , when I do that , I have literally gone , ok I’m going to concede for a moment that I’m a shit bodybuilder by doing this and just going to try to lift as much weight as I can
So point in case again , I can overhead press 5 plates on the smith at peak strength but only super revved , I can’t do it not super revved , so I haven’t built the muscle to do it . So instead of wasting time , effort , risk of injury getting super revved just to lift the weight all things that a good bodybuilder wouldn’t do , I can just be a normal level of focused lift the weight I can do and in time build the muscle to keep producing ever increasing force

Small comment on post show rebounds
Ok , so we have alllll blown up post show , i don’t know a single person who hasn’t , however the rates at which you can add contractile tissue do not change much  ! Yes your super sensitive to carbs and insulin and sleep increases and you have all the tools there to maximise growth, but the rate at which we can actually add contractile tissue , is limited . It’s like one man building a house , sure you can get a fucking beast who can build fast ! But one man can only build so fast ! So if you Chuck all the tools , all the food , all the drugs , the building can only occur , so fast
So I would say , realistically , your looking at 1-1.5 pounds a month of actual contractile tissue b, if your super freaky , you can do 2 pounds a month of actual contractile tissue.
So if you go up 30/40 pounds in month one , you have still only added 2 pounds of tissue! And when you diet back down , the rest will just be gone again . Pushing yourself up super fast , will cost you around the 8 week mark I will say , that’s when you will then start to turn into a melted candle , and your training will go to shit and you will need to mini cut, and in that 8 weeks you will of gained 3-4 pounds of stage weight , if you trained really damn hard and got straight into progressive overload! A 6 month well executed offseason , can defo see a 12 pound increase in Stage weight , but man you have got to be on the money to get that , and blowing up post show is the fastest way to fuck that all up
That being said , we have all done it , I feel agajn it’s one of those things you have to do and learn from and then diet back down after to go, oh fuck I gained lirerally no muscle because I had to diet so hard to get the 50 pounds of shit weight back off 😂🤷🏼‍♂️ , or you can listen to me And try super super hard to not do that and actually make some progress

thread_title: JP prep 2024/25 – NO OFF TOPIC QUESTIONS
author: Jordan Peters
content:
A common theme I’m noticing when people asking about progressing lifts .
They will ask “ when do I go for a rep or increase weight “ . This question honestly does confuse me A LOT , because you don’t get to choose when you go for a rep . That gets given to you when your programming is right and recovery is right , there is no in the moment choice there. So the answer is you are always trying to add a rep, or more . The goal is always to try . But when that gets given to you has absolutely nothing to do with any thing other than knowing it’s a process where some sessions it will be there and others it won’t . So simply , add 0.5-1.25  always , and then still try to take your rep . If you don’t take it , you have added load , so then still got as close as you can to a very hard rep which is what causes most stimulation

author: Jordan Peters
content: Change exercises when they come a risk , and then revisit them . I got up to 11 plates a side on the Atlantis incline , so you have a LOT of wiggle room to keep going , the only reason 11 became hard is because of the lockout / ascending resistance profile . So I would rejig your mind a little . Very strong is Eddie hall , the rest of us aren’t there yet , so don’t for a moment think, Ah where do I go from here, you aren’t even remotely close to be thinking that . So just in the meantime , change movements , Rinse those , repeat repeat Repeat

I think your just missing the point which is maybe a language barrier
Fat loss is simply energy balance . Cardio is not disruptive to fat loss , kuba has never said this or ever will. The more you move , the more fat you burn, moving faster for longer  = more fat loss
Do you NEED cardio , is the question .
And the answer is it depends , girls defo do , they will never create an energy deficit big enough alone from steps until they are very very advanced and have had complete control of their body fat levels for a long period of time
Guys new to things may need it , this is just because they can’t maintain their NEAT levels very well
Big guys , likely won’t NEED cardio . Does some help still , ye sure , there js likely some mitochondria efficiency that occurs from cardio that allows for more effective fat loss , but is this trade off for simply steps , worth it for a big bodybuilder , probably not

author: Jordan Peters
content:
My training started aged 12 at Crystal Palace Olympic weight lifting centre , I trained 3 times a week , we trained lifts not body parts but how that ended up looking was essentially 3 full body sessions a week
Eg
Mon :
Cleans
Bench press
Chins
Jumps
Wed :
High pull
Ohead press
Seal row
Jumps
Fri :
A snatch pull variation
Dips
Chins
Jumps
So my first exposure to anything was full body
After that my s and c coaches when I moved to wasps employed basically the same approach , but it was sometimes upper / lower Style
Once I was 16/17/18 I became very aware of how much my strength was a key aspect of
My game , so I wanted to learn more to get stronger , bigger , fitter , faster , so just started to consume everything possible info wise
The best bodybuilding info that seemed the most logical to me was Dante / Dr Scott , so I read eveyrhtjng there was to read , never posted , didn’t have anything to say , not like now , where people train for 6 months and chime in with “ Shouldn’t you do X , as they saw it 5 mins earlier on another page “ , I had trained for 6 years but still had nothing to say, just read it all, I was in no position to try to understand their approaches or rationale , 18 year old me knew that , blows my mind how 30 + year old adults can’t get that into their mind now
Didn’t get resigned by wasps at 18 , so started bodybuilding, removed all the power moves and jumps from training and ran with upper lower , introduced some rest pause , it was like a modified Dc style based on just what I was already doing ; same structure really as I advocate now , 17 years later still works exactly the same
During this period started to communicate with Dr Scott and Dante , so I was around 20 then , and had just competed in my first show , they took notice that I wasn’t fucking around and I was growing fast , so they helped me a lot
Hired dr Scott shortly after , and then started to learn the how and why of the things I was doing , I had figured out a ton already by trial and error , but his perspective solidified it for me In terms of understanding how to programme
Then spent the next ten years trying to
Get as big as possible , trying everything there is to try to fully understand every single aspect
Of bodybuilding training
Here we are , I’m still doing the same thing , seeing what is doable , what isn’t , asking myself questions and trying to find the answers

author: Jordan Peters
content:
Self assessment
We have had a huge influx of questions and posts on here, which is great . The majority evolve around what split to do and 99
percent is really well thought out and it’s awesome to see. Something very clear though, an inability to self assess one’s position and a thought process that changing splits or lowering drugs is a step back. It doesn’t matter how much muscle you have gained to this point, there is absolutely nothing inherently important To a split, that’s just how you communicate what your doing.  All that matters is the number of hard sets you expose your muscle to, when they adapt, you will be able to lift more to re create that hard set , so it’s important you add more load, to keep that scenario of hard set, to keep forcing further adaptations. How that looks as split is irrelevant, and when you have less muscle, the more often you can do it the better. You are never too advanced to go back to full Body if you can recover from it, pros likely can’t, so
please keep them out of mind, just think , create stimulus, body adapts, as often as possible – that’s it. The next is drugs, if you look like you have never used gear but are taking 1-2g of drugs , you must Must must go back to 300mg and simply learn to eat and train, you just need to actually be honest with yourself
you know in your self you aren’t actually sticking to your diet or eating your protein feedings 5-6 times a day, you know this ! You don’t have to tell anyone else if it’s a facade you keep up but surely you want to actually look like you do this right !? So back to 300mg total anabolics a week, test only if that’s what feels best a bit of mast and slightly lower test if that feels better ( only way is to try both ), if e2 is still too high, take the same test dose but instead of mast use primo. And then from here , stimulus as often as possible, progress lifts to keep doing hard sets, 5-6 protein feedings a day and once your actually stringing together lift progressions , you will change. The only issue is your emotional attachments , they will cost you everything, your poor decision making and not
inability to assess your position is from emotional attachments , you want to feel like you are better than you are to make yourself feel better for the actual fact you know you suck at this, I see it A LOT . But guess what, you can actually get good if you stop with the poor, but also strange decision making and accept that you can’t drug your way to looking like you take this seriously.

thread_title: Blast during bulk or blast during cut?
author: Jordan Peters
content:
Keeping muscle in a diet is easy until it comes to getting peeled , you don’t need the same mg
Yes you may deflate a little , but that’s just visual , it’s not muscle , eg re add the dose and in 3 weeks the visual has changed , you haven’t regained any lost muscle , as you didn’t lose it , you just adjusted the visual
So for the majority , I would diet on less
This changes when competing , then I would start a little lower as you will likely have had a clear out befroe starting anyways , so can re add doses below peak and then leave yourself somewhere to go
If you have got truly legit , that’s when can have a break as food will protect anything from being lost further until it’s grow time .
So some hypothetical numbers
1000mg total push up , then cruise on 200mg after push , then start ti diet on 500 , increase max to 700 , then after the diet go back to the 1000 as you start to push up
Prep
1000 push up , 200 cruise , prep starts on 500 and increases upto 1000 , after prep 200 again , then once ready to start growing start back at 500 and rebuild again to 1000

This number is going to be a constantly changing number based on your activity levels and the only way of actually getting your cal needs is running it and adjusting it accordingly based on Your weight moving up or down

Hey , I feel like I can progress legs after back easily , but after legs my ability to progress back is lower
Much like I can progress back after push no problem but if I was to try to do push work after back I can progress it the same
What you do at the start of the sessions impacts the stuff at the end, so pick your exercise order that allows you to progress everything maximally

thread_title: How to structure cut (muscle loss on a cut)
author: Jordan Peters
content:
Don’t worry about it at all, you need to look at the bigger picture , at the end of the end of the push up you will have more muscle than ever before
Try to remember this , when a decent bodybuilder competes , they try to get as lean as they possibly can and in that process they may lose some muscle, that’s part of it because you typically can’t get truly lean without losing some and then everyone is in the same boat , so the competition is who can get the leanest and hold the most , but that doesn’t mean worrying you have lost even some.
Get as lean as you can , accept muscle will come off a bit , each push phase start with more muscle than the previous ( not hard if you go back up slow) , and then each diet try to end leaner than the previous and see if you can lose less muscle
It’s all a process that really doesn’t need any “ worry “ , at any point . When I see the words worry in this context, it’s a bit of a sign of potential there to hold someone back from achieving a really good physique , because of irrational worries

author: Jordan Peters
content:
Absolutely none of it has any rules to it whatsoever , that’s the point that is trying to be consistently made that is seems is super hard for beginners to understand
It seems like beginners are looking for rules , like in maths or physics and want training to have a same equation style approach
It doesn’t
So for the 1000th time lol
Start with weaknesses
Do 2-4 sets per muscle
Don’t do 4 sets for eveyrthing as total session volume gets too high
That’s it , so everything you have said , in any variation you have seen, fits into that set up
So the next time you come to ask a Q on upper/ lower programming , just fall back to these 3 tips
Start with weaknesses
2-4 sets a muscle
Don’t do 4 sets for each muscle as session volume gets too high
Do that for 5 years , this is the only number part that truly matters , you want a numbers game , do upper / lower for 60 months , focus on that number , while sticking to the tips above

author: Jordan Peters
content:
You need an abundance of raw material ( calories ) , to build something new , you can’t build a house without any new material . So food is the driver of everything
Anabolics facilitate a more efficient process when increasing food and a higher proportion of the new material is used as muscle vs fat , the slower and more patient you go in your caloric increases the more likely again you will maximise muscular gains, providing your creating the consistent stimulus in the gym

thread_title: Am I just not meant to be a bodybuilder
author: Jordan Peters
content:
Your expectations are way off buddy
This game takes YEARS
I started lifting at 12 , but really properly lifting , I was training at the British weightlifting centre being coached 1-1 by the GB Olympic lifting coach , I trained with him from 12-15 , 3 times a week . Then from 15-18 I trained with some unreal s and c coaches when I was at wasps
These were very very hard sessions , every time .
At 18 I defo was bigger than any other 18 I knew by a long way, but I didn’t look anything like a proper bodybuilder
I started competing in bodybuilding at 18 ( I believe competing will force
You to improve really really fast ) , and then I would say by 21/22 started to look like a bodybuilder for the first time
So 10 years just to start to look like a proper bodybuilder , with some
Of the best coaching , and me competing a lot between 18-21.
Then it took me I’d say another 5-6 years to become a big big bodybuilder . So 16 years it took me to reach a point where people go, holy fucking shit your big , in that time I committed every single ounce of my whole being to this
So , I would say , your expectations and timelines are a little off wouldn’t you ?
What you need at this point really is, nobody cares work harder . You are sad that you don’t look and feel as big as you want to, no one cares . The only way to get what you want is to work harder ( and to adjust your expectations back to somewhere close to reality )
I would get peeled and compete personally , rebound from there gain a ton of muscle , compete again, repeat repeat repeat . Do that for 3-4 years , you will be unreal ( or don’t and in 3-4 years you will probably still be feeling sad that your not the bodybuilder you wished you were )

Firstly , well done on that initial push ! That takes a lot of strength , from an ED perspective .
Don’t over think this 70kg number and how lean it is, your new to this and learning , but you already understand the process needed to actually change, so that is HUGE! Many never grasp it and never change
From 70kg I would be keen for you to go to 80kg again but patiently , really let that take 20-24  weeks
Where these phases can still yield minimal results, is if they are rushed .
So 20-24 week push and then a slow diet ! Back to 70kg , where then I guarentee it will be much leaner , and then after that back to 80kg but the next diet will likely only be to say 72kg but that will be even leaner again !
This game takes time , and it’s going to be a slow patient process , but you will get yourself to a lean 80kg in a few years which will just look absolutely unreal vs the skinny fat 68kg start point
Patience , and hard training 🙂

thread_title: How Much Fat is Stored From a Cookie? (Example)
author: Jordan Peters
content:
Well are you still in a caloric deficit for the day or not? As if you are , you will utilise all the fuel in the cookie as energy and store zero as fat .
So let’s say your currently needing 2500 cals to maintain your weight , and you have eaten 2000 of your cals for the day and then final 500 you have the cookie , and you do this every day. Your body fat levels won’t change
If you lower your cals and only eat 1700 cals
For the day and then have the cookie , you will drop stored body fat
If you then did 20 mins cardio ontop of the above , but still Are the cookie , you would drop even more fat
Does that help explain energy balance ?

thread_title: What dosage for sus and Decca
author: Jordan Peters
content:
Jon, a lot to unpack here
The combo of testosterone + nandrolone , will often see e2 levels uncontrollable for 9/10
People , the addition of Dianabol ontop is then just awful awful, compared to much smarter cycle options
If your dead set on the combo of a testosterone with nandrolone , I would run the test ( sustanon  in your case ) , low . Circa 150mg a week , and then this will allow you to comfortably use nandrolone ontop at a higher dose , being the drug that aromatises the less of the two ( in most people by a long way ) . Nandrolone dose , depending on how experienced you are , could be 200mg / week to 600mg per week
I would start low, based on the question , as I don’t think you will need much. And then if at some point in the cycle there was a need to make anabolic additions , I would then consider masteron as your next choice
So it could look
Weeks 1-6
150mg test / week ( most of us hate sustanon on here , it’s a silly drug that makes little sense , so if you can change to test e , that’s advisable )
200mg nandrolone decanoate / week
Weeks 6-12
The above stays
+ 300mg / week masteron e
If your training and nutrition is on point , the above would be very easy to gain 10-15 pounds of lean tissue

So I tend to think of it in terms of what the lat does and doesn’t attach to.
The lat doesn’t attach the scapula , it goes from base of spine to back of upper arm, so if you pull those two points together without letting scap retraction be a focus – this is lat focused
If you initiate the pull with scapula retractors , your going to get less lat as the prime mover And the upper back musculature will dominate the movement
Letting the arm stray from the side of the body but then keeping scapula retraction out, will see more of a rear delt row
I like training scapula retraction movements dual armed , I think they are move more powerful

thread_title: Adjusting Insulin Requirements based on BG
author: Jordan Peters
content:
Wasn’t the Lantus that made you fat , you just got fat
The titration up of the dose is in sync with caloric increases , but if BG is too low then you don’t increase the insulin , DO NOT add more food to allow for more insulin
Fast insulin at the wo perimeter is then a good option , just go very steady with it all !

thread_title: Adjusting Insulin Requirements based on BG
author: Jordan Peters
content:
At 20iu , you got fatter as you rushed your caloric increase
So the framework for effective use is, get super lean – like very lean , initially bring body up 5-6 pounds to drop fatigue , then very very slowly take your body weight up , 1 pound a week
( the above is the general frame we advise for just everyone )
Add in 5iu of Lantus
Then at that rate of gain of body eight , go up initially very slowly in the Lantus too. So after 2-3 weeks, 6iu , another couple weeks 7iu etc etc then you will be upto 15-20iu / day and all it will of done is helped facilitate your above overall offseason approach

277 this morn, weight jumped.
In the last month, it feels like my physique has stepped forward hugely, this is absolutely dose correlated . I built my physique largely
On 3.5g of drugs a week…. So it seems more and more obvious that I can’t get back to exactly where I was unless I’m pushing as hard a as I was . I did think I could get there on much less , but I can only react to what Is going on.

Feels like based on the look today  , I would be better served going back down again sooner , but again just on a more representative dosage of what it takes to get to where I was before .
Defo shows that this path of regaining muscle isn’t as clear cut as I expected it to be , as I dieted for 8 weeks and then been growing again for 4 and then think, hmmm if I got super
Super tight now , I could focus on constantly keeping my waist smaller instead of more food and more stress on it. Regaining muscle basically is just about taking the max drugs you used before and not fucking around I would say , so for anyone that stopped like I did , if you got legit big like me and did it majority of the time on 3-3.5g , I would start back on say 2g and then get back to 3G fairly soon and you will regain it much faster , I wasted a ton of time fucking around on 1g and then 2g and now finally seeing a response on 2.5g that resembles more what I had before , 3G will see a big change again I think

thread_title: Potential tear? Approach advice for recovery.
author: Jordan Peters
content:
can you stretch and contract it without pain today? if so, get a light band and do 5 x 30 reps single arm pulldown tonight and flood it with blood, do them slow and listen to your body . Do the same tmo or if in gym tmo do it on the cable at end of your session, do this daily until next back session
next back session train the gd side as normal, bad side, do a bit more than have been doing on the single cable the last few days , if getting literally zero feedback, do a little more
next few days after , same thing – daily 5 x 30 pulldowns , seeing if can slightly creep the load a tiny bit pain free, next back session still same , gd arm as usual, bad side just creep a bit more
repeat repeat repeat until healed
very minor fibre pops, may mean 10 days until you can load to failure in light rep ranges
my lat tear took the above for 10 ish weeks, daily work of creeping loading

author: Jordan Peters
content:
in its most basic answer, they have to go somewhere, so mix them or have a pro fat meal – the diff in reality is zero from a fat loss perspective , as energy balance is all that matters. It plays a role in the influence of digestion and the rate of uptake of foods , and this will make diff people feel diff things . for some , they may have more sustained energy adding 10-12g of fat with 70-80g of carbs, for others it may make them feel less energetic. Macro combinations are ENTIRELY based on preference, as if you eat a meal and say , i feel awesome, my digestion and energy and mood and focus are all superb, then you have worked out the best combo. So start trying things. From coaching lots of people, i found 75-100g carbs a meal with 10-12g fat , worked superbly well. If your cal requirements are less , it maybe 60c with 8f , or 50c with 6f . Atm on training days i have 120c with 20f .
the reason? all of the reasons we need fats , all of their roles , that protein and carbs cannot do. Hormone production, lipid management ,  anti inflammatory actions, some vitamins are only fat soluble , blood glucose control , cell health .

thread_title: Should i continue the gaining phase or start the cut?
author: Jordan Peters
content: so my position is this, if you just keep endlessly growing, you are getting zero practice in getting lean and also will be adding more fat and in another year, you will have a gd chunk of fat , yes a lot of muscle but more fat than needed vs if you just spent 8-10 weeks dieting and getting leannn , and then another 6 months growing again. i think the more you repeat those cycles, each time you will find it easier to get lean lean and each push up you will learn more about what volume brought the best results. So imo, whip the fat off soon, and then have another 30/40/50 pound push, repeat that process 4-5 times over the next couple years and you will then be 18 , 30 pounds over a legit peeled stage weight, already worked out how many steps feels too many, how much cardio feels too much, how low cals need to go etc etc – all these things you will have all the answers to, so the moment you decide to compete, you arent then in some guessing game of , how do i diet , you have built all the muscle and are totally ready to then do the same diet as last time but then just finish off the last bit. You are literally in a spot to learn how to become an ifbb pro by age 19/20 if you really want to!

author: Jordan Peters

hey hey ,
i think it depends on safety and then un warranted fatigue
for me , i have to usually start a bit lighter and then as sets go on i can add weight and let reps drop
on the compound movements also, your going to be able to get much closer to failure , truly knowing you cant do another rep, with slightly higher reps
so on days my knees feel really great i may go 12/10/8/6 , increasing the load each set, every set taken all the way there
on days my knees are meh it may have to be 20/15/12/8 , this one defo comes with way more fatigue but i can usually get more effective reps from this way too m. if fitness is flying and your fatigue resilience is high, Like Corinne, she does on leg press 12/10/8/5/20 , so that last one going back down lighter feels super light and then can grind out alll the effective reps.
the rest of the iso stuff, i think sticking 8-12 is wise , i stray heavier always as i just like 6/7 rep sets , but i think most will do better on iso work with 8-12 , so then if you have multiple sets, adjust the resistance profile as you go and then just stay in that rep range zone and just stay connected to the muscle

firstly it depends on where its placed in a session, fresh, 60/40 or 50/50 is the start point and then increasing the loading at the same proportions, so atm im upto 3 + 2.5 mid and same top, so next session i will do 3+ 3.75 mid and same top , as sets go on and we lose the ability to maintain strength in the shortened aspect of tbe lift, load is distributed to where we retain strength in the loaded
i have played endlessly with all the pieces , my whole game in the gym is working out how to progress, thats why the bottom peg on this piece is redundant
equally , as kuba pointed out, bottom peg loaded so you can just launch the machine into a lockout literally poses minimal hypertrophy benefits. If you want to get super dense , get outrageously strong in the lengthened range, if you spend any amount of time pressing solely that bottom peg, you will go to db press or barbell press or any other machine and be so piss weak, as you wont of done any work at all in the lengthened position ( this is also a really bad injury risk not doing any work there and then trying to do some on another piece)
i will get this to 4 mid and 4 top this year for defo now i have worked out the loading to keep progressing and the gains from that approach will be so so big

thread_title: Tbol vs Anadrol in a diet phase.
author: Jordan Peters
content:
Anadrol won’t come with more water than tbol when lean, anadrol doesn’t aromatise. It may bring more IM fullness but it’s literally all IM
These aren’t comparable drugs at the end of a diet as one aromatises and one doesn’t , not many people , tbh anyone at all is adding an aromatising drug at the end of a prep
Your either adding anadrol or superdrol – don’t aromatise , bump fullness
Winny or Anavar , actively lower e2 , make you drier but less full
These are the usual decisions people opt between

thread_title: I always feel like I need to change something
author: Jordan Peters
content:
It’s very normal now I think because of social media , your constantly looking at other peoples progress and thinking that you need to be doing more , the downside of this , is that you just don’t enjoy any of the process .
I’m 33 now, been gd at 2 diff sports and competed a lot in them , now trying to get gd at a 3rd sport and my first comp is 12 weeks away, all that matters is enjoying the process because you only get one crack at your early years in something before then it transitions into something more serious and more like work , both those previous sports did that for me , and simply because of how I focus on progressing , this will too, so I know it’s very very important to enjoy absolutely every part of this one .
My advise is very much the same , just focus on the enjoyment . You look very young in the pics , try to focus on having fun, enjoying training and making decent memories . I fucking LOVED my training when I was 18 , there was no social media ,  no bollocks to get distracted by , I simply trained as hard as I could then went and sat on the beach and had an ice cream for post workout

author: Jordan Peters
content:
In time you will know what one to do more / less of, as one will bring you more joy than the other , and at that point it won’t even be a decision, you will just do more of one and less of the other .
( this sort of thing never crossed my mind when I was 13/14/15, I was playing tons of diff sports and lifting and I just did it all , until then it simmered down to just 2 things – rugby and lifting , and then rugby stopped and it was just lifting . Don’t even think about it, just crack on and have fun )

author: Jordan Peters
content:
Firstly it’s defo important to be up to date with medical science / physiology . High kidney protein intake has absolutely zero impact on healthy kidneys
Second it’s important to understand the nutritional literature in regards to protein over feeding – Jose Antonio studies are the most reputable here , that during uptake of 4.4g/kg per day, there is not only no additional fat gain, when the excess caloric consumption comes from protein , but there is an increase in muscle mass and decrease in body fat . What we can take away from the protein over feeding studies is they pose zero disadvantages in a healthy gut , and only positives
Hopefully with those two VITAL pieces of science now in your Arsenal of knowledge , you will understand why the protein intake is set where it is 🙂 .
Now that’s the science part
Anecdotally , based on the coaching of myself, Dante and Milos – we all saw much greater progress on that amount in clients

thread_title: How much should you Warm up before your topsets?
author: Jordan Peters
content:
Everyones warm up is person dependant , I would personally never go on a stair machine before an exercise , especially chest !
For me , if I do an incline barbell press for example , I would do 60kg x 5 , 100kg x 3 , 120kg x 2 , 140kg x 1 , 160kg x 1 , 180kg x whatever I would get – at my best 10 reps
I don’t stretch , I don’t do any mobility . I have never got hurt doing a set in that style . Only have I ever got hurt when I would then go 180kg x 1 , 200kg x 1 and then 220kg x work set and then this being so heavy i pop fibres . So my injuries aren’t warm up related they are weight related , which is inevitable when trying to lift stuff that’s super super heavy

thread_title: Drop sets in a caloric deficit & surplus
author: Jordan Peters
content: Not much to add to the above , the last 5 reps are based on the way our body starts to maximally recruit high threshold motor units, so if we are using a heavy heavy weight , it will do that from rep one , but doing a 30 rep set , it’s only at the very end of the set will we start to use every single fibre we have , to do the work – that’s where the term effective reps came into play , it’s a useful visual because when people do high rep sets, or even moderate rep sets , if they don’t understand that it’s the last few reps that are getting closer to true failure , are the ones that are going to cause the cascade of adaptive signalling there after – you can term those effective reps , so I like the phrase a fair bit in that context

author: Jordan Peters
content:
Blood flow ASAP
I have taken the same approach for 4 fairly bad muscle tears now and it works very well
The moment you can move the adductor in that plane of motion pain free , do that 30 times x 5 for a few days . For me, I could do it very slowly after day 3 post injury. The first couple days it was too sore to move at all
I did that for 3-4 days and twice a day I could move it a little comfier without any biting pain . After that I went to a very very thin band tension, so literally the thinnest band you can get , and added that standing , twice a day – always avoiding pain . Within a few days I could use slightly thicker band , always avoiding any pain . It took a few weeks of that and I was then using a fairly thick band and the healing was well under way . The important part is not to set it back , by jumping too fast
In the gym I could leg extend and leg curl at 100 percent and also could light stiff leg too –
Find out what you can and can’t do to work around it
Keep increasing band thickness and keep testing what you can and can’t do movement wise . I was able to leg extend and ham curl within days , as it didn’t effect the area at all
It took me I think 4 weeks to be very light hack squatting because of how much I rehabbed it but I couldn’t do an empty leg press still as that put stretch on it. I slowly built my hack over the next 4 weeks while still doing banded rehab daily and I was quickly doing decent stuff on the hack, but I still couldn’t leg press at all
Took me ages until I could
Leg press , I have only just got back on the 45 degree one . But I just did other movements I could do, so I didn’t really miss any leg training at all tbh. The key is movement , rehab like a lunatic , and working around it
I did this for for my lat, pec , quad and adductor all perfectly

thread_title: How does training volume differ between female and male ?
author: Jordan Peters
content:
The reasoning behind frequency and volume, is down to strength . Smaller / weaker guys can do more volume and higher frequency work also as the training they do , is less disruptive – there is less muscle damage.
A stronger female will be able to do less volume than a weaker female , however a strong female will still be able to do in most cases more volume than most males .

thread_title: Are aminos a waste of money?
author: Jordan Peters
content: We all echo the same thing , maybe you have seen some of my stories that document the scientific reasoning behind why you would or wouldn’t buy them. Eaa aren’t a scam, but if someone isn’t educated in how muscle protein synthesis works , that’s on them. If your eating protein every 3 or so hours, your doing a gd job of offsetting muscle protein breakdown and driving muscle protein synthesis , this means you need to be eating close to the workout . For a lot of us, we don’t like that a we train really hard and prefer a fairly empty stomach, in this instance taking in some eaa during a session, 2 hours after your last feeding , 2 hours before your next feeding is a perfect way to aid in mps . Why not a complete protein here ? If it’s Pepto pro or a very high quality hydro whey , that’s great as they are pre digested , however an eaa is free form amino acids which needs even less digestion , this means less shunting of blood to the stomach at this point , so overall efficiency stays high in regards to performance but also aiding in mps status . This is pretty solid science and generally all agreed upon in the scientific community . So are they a useful tool, yes. Are they a scam – no. Do you need to understand how to use them, yes

author: Jordan Peters
content:
When Corinne and i studied this for our masters , what it actually came down to a lot was perceived difficulty in some vs others .
So what I mean by that, is that some complained that others found it easy to lose weight , and it was actually not because one had to do more, but because one couldn’t do the same amount as the one that found it “ easy”
Eg , 2 people are same height, sex , weight
One eats 2000 cals a day,
Does 20 mins cardio a day and 10,000
Steps a day
The other eats 3000, doesn’t do cardio and does 5000 steps – but moans that they have it harder to lose weight . They just never fully comprehend the work done by others
Energy balance always rules, NOTHING can overcome a deficit , but what occurs 100
Percent of the time is people think they are in a deficit and they aren’t , and then don’t understand they simply don’t adhere to the same level as those in a deficit

If you use the machine later in the session, just top peg load it, don’t bother with any mid peg work

thread_title: How to become a online coach and be a very good one
author: Jordan Peters
content:
There are a lot of things that go into it
– your knowledge
– your ability to communicate
– your ability to motivate
– your ability to empathise
– then we have marketing , organisation/ time management
The first , i would go to every seminar you can from anyone that Is decent , listen to every podcast by anyone that is decent – be relentless with this part , for most of us it’s like a hobby so we can passively have podcasts on all the time and absorb info.
The next 3 , get better the more people you work with , it takes time to learn that diff people need diff things
The last 2 , for that you may just be gd at these or you may need to hire someone to help you as some point – lots of people that help you with your business management side of things
For me, I never hired a single person to help me with my business , i I simply focused on learning as much as I could , and then focused on helping people – the rest fell into place

author: Jordan Peters

Summer dieting and winter bulking isn’t a bad approach at all, it’s the same as competing and offseason , you need periods of being leaner to set you up for periods of growth , otherwise your just a perma bulk fat mess – we all know these haha, but I totally get your want to just maintain a weight and look now – this is wise , it could still have mini tidy ups
I like all the questions you have asked here, they are the same I ask myself literally everyday atm, shall I just stick to a 300mg total, or shall I still entertain the idea of primo additions.
I think it depends a lot on how you feel and where you believe your health is at and if your going to be a lot better off health wise being a bit smaller , a bit fitter etc
I know for me, that if I do even small primo runs, I can literally keep all my muscle and stay very heavy as a result , so I know for me, that I must must try to not re add it , even at like 200-300mg ontop of test base as I know that’s enough drugs for me to stay 260 + no problem – which is dumb! It’s dumb from a health perspective.
If you can run those little extras , and your body weight be at a place that isn’t going to see your body under crazy stress, I think that’s ok , but At this stage now your having these discussions , wouldn’t it be nice to just never have to think about a cycle again!? And it just be a perma 250 or whatever dose you pick. Morning guys and girls 🙂
Lovely weekend away , I really needed it as my body was utterly destroyed and I was mentally
Exhausted from this push so far and juggling everything that we juggle atm , it’s surprised me this last month how much harder it is now to be in “ competitor mode” , and do what we need to, to successful keep the business growing – on the daily the levels of communication with our staff , supplier + manufacturers and our customers, is increasing and it’s certainly difficult to mentally manage fatigue, as always when I get too stressed , I will hand over communication To Corinne and she will take over whatever I was doing when I can feel I’m about to lose my shit at someone , this helps A LOT . Ate a ton of shit over the weekend, laughed A LOT , met tons of hilarious people in the hospitality section at the stadium – big diff between Murrayfield and twickenham, Murrayfield feels like a posh comedy club , the food is amazing , and the atmosphere is very funny and social , everyone wants to chat with you , you could easily go and sit at some random person table ( even though it’s laid out like a restaurant ) and just talk and they would legit want to chat back and just have a laugh with you ( I love this about Scottish people , well the ones I have met through bb and rugby )
Twickenham is very posh, you couldn’t just mingle like that, it’s quieter and less rowdy, it’s very much “ we are VIPs in our hospitality box”type feel. It’s nice to experience both, I just don’t like pretentious people – would be cool to have the layout of twickenham with the atmosphere of Murrayfield!

thread_title: Thougths on Flexible Diet and Diet Rotations
author: Jordan Peters
content:
A lot of us will eat with a flexible structure , in that during an offseason when cals are high , we may swap rice for cream of rice , or swap red meat for fish , or swap seeds for seed butter , or have one type of fruit over another – however the focus will still be on quality of food , hitting the types of fat we want , the fibre needed and carbs that digest the best. This level of flexibility allows you a fairly nice variety of food choices but keeps things extremely accurate and in line with the goal.
Just eating anything and cracking it into my fitness pal, no I think that’s pretty sub par , that’s how I used to eat when I was 16/17/18 years old , I would eat and just tally up my calories for the day and just make sure I hit my calories needed , it’s a pretty meh approach if the goals you vocalise having are high . If the goal is to just look decent, be fairly strong and the biggest priority is flexibility , it’s ideal . If you utter the words that you want to be better than just decent , be way more accurate and control things more

No, now your deep into the cycle it’s totally fine . The issue with the start of decanoate cycles is the timeframe to build up e2
To a satisfactory level where you feel good. We know the e2 elevation is so much less than test , so with a long ester , there will be a period where your e2 will be sub par . So my advice in general here – if your running under 1g , use npp , if your going over 1g , decanoate will be fine. If you only have decanoate , start with a little dbol to bridge that build up of e2

author: Jordan Peters
content:
I know without a doubt that the way Kuba and I have built our muscle , we would regress training like that. I literally did- I got weaker and weaker , to the point where I remember unracking 180kg and it feeling heavy and rdl with it felt hard! That was a real , ok this training is defo not for me moment , as I have bashed out 25 reps with 180 before , so to them get like 7-8 reps and it feel like a deadweight from doing tons of sets over a period that didn’t get stuck into effective reps, was hugely sub par.
Now I notice of late there is a slight shift in the narrative surrounding it, and it is one I agree with – it’s that , “ not many people train to failure anyways and use an rir approach” . This is true , most people I see train don’t get stuck into hard reps , and then when you are training heavy – it’s actually not always safe to even attempt those Grindy reps . This is why I love high rep sets for things like leg press as you can really get stuck into effective reps, which are truly the ones that recruit all fibres . I would defo urge people to try taking reps to failure , get to a rep that you need a slight hands on to complete the rep , and then see if over subsequent weeks , that you then are able to take that rep all you, and then with more weight on that rep , etc etc – the rir approach really holds back the pace of progression with loading , it really will stop you getting strong , and that, is the key to getting really very big, being able to use large loading with standardised form across lots of rep ranges

author: Jordan Peters
content:
Great answer Max
I will add , the “ back off set “ , doesn’t challenge the nervous system
In a novel fashion, it doesn’t challenge the connective tissue in a novel fashion – the lighter set feels much better in both those aspects – so actually it’s the exact opposite to what you have said, it brings about more blood flow ( mechanism of hypertrophy) , without adding any additional stress that the body needs to adapt to , so from a stimulus to fatigue ratio perspective the back off set is brilliant . It also is safer – it’s very rare you will get hurt in a back off set after a heavy set , what this lends itself to is actually grinding out “ effective reps “ , especially if it’s a 20 rep back off, you can literally grind to the death , grabbing every last fibre without any risk. You can’t do this on a heavy set, as grinding to that extent brings a huge injury risk.
I have also answered your question here Kuastuv, the first set doesn’t cover all mechanisms of hypertrophy , the second set does via what I have discussed above
Both of you are totally over analysing training and are really far off the mark as to what’s actually going on

thread_title: How import is consider resistence profile on exercice selection in your workout?
author: Jordan Peters
content: To add aswell , the lat , due to its anatomical structure is probably the hardest muscle to get short fully , under fatigue it’s almost impossible to use any kind of loading in the short – so that really is a key muscle to start with an exercise that overloads the short and end on things that drop off . Quads less so, you can still get them short under fatigue with a large amount of force and the only exercise that can fully shorten it with is the leg ext – so that has more flexibility as to where it features jn your session

thread_title: How import is consider resistence profile on exercice selection in your workout?
author: Jordan Peters
content: Very very very . It’s something I have always done for a very long time , as the goal is to lift the most amount of weight across a whole session , this is how we grow the most. Order exercises wrong and you simply can’t lift as much load . For example , rarely will you want to end with an exercise that overloads the shortened position – it makes zero sense . In 2013/14 when i first started to get strong I would place my hammer strength movements first always as I noticed I couldn’t ever load as much at the end of the session , however if I did a dumbbell press that has a more even resistance profile , I could still lift heavy. I can’t stress how important it is. I look at sessions now written by coaches that think they know what their talking about and just chuckle to myself .

author: Jordan Peters
content: Because I tore my lat doing sldl , so now I pulldown first to get it all warm , as my lat attachment is still vulnerable in that area . Most people would benefit from a lat focused pulldown first anyways , as generally will get spine warm and then mobility will be decent for pulls

author: Jordan Peters
content: That study is void , the comparisons aren’t valid . They aren’t making pre and post comparisons , so there is no data collected at the start of the study which is compared to the end of the study , and then rate of change compared to other groups. It’s simply end of 12th week tests compared directly to each other . We don’t know how people were prior to coming into the study and furthermore we don’t exactly know what anyone was taking , because no one was actually given steroids , it was their own self reported use , which we know can be messy . Less so here in the U.K as we have good labs , but basically anywhere else , no one can categorically say they know exactly what they are taking . So if no pre to post comparisons are made and we don’t know with any certainty what people are taking , how can we draw anything conclusive from the study? Seems that what passes for a study in Turkey is a little diff to here or the USA haha

Based on the torn the lat a little bit , I’m going to just tell you what I did for my last 3 tears.
The next day I see if I can just take it through rom feedback free , if I can’t , I leave it alone until I can, this may take a couple days with a small tear. Once I can take it through full rom I get to work daily flooding it with blood
My last lat tear, within a few days I was doing very very Thin band single arm pulldowns , literally giving me like 5kg resistance, I did 30 reps , 4 sets , a couple times a day
From there I slowly increased the band resistance , 6/7/8/9 kg over the next 7-10 days
Then after that single arm pulldowns in the gym on the same incremental increase , everytime you step in to train anybodypart . Do 4-5 sets of 20-30 reps , days out of the gym use the bands
Keep going up in weight until your then back to full strength , may take you 2 weeks , may take you 12 .
This is my approach , and it works great

author: Jordan Peters
content:
This is defo high e2 ,
Nandrolone when combined with test is often a cause of issue , nandrolone as a standalone compound rarely causes anyone issue ( provided you take enough to get e2 levels in a gd spot ) but when combined with test , it’s often a further increase in prolactin than just test or just the nandrolone dose ( they both raise it) , and if also causes a further increase in e2 greater than what just the standalone dose of nandrolone would result in …. So everything you are experiencing is e2 sides – so options , drop the nandrolone for primo , this will help control e2 from that 500 test and still bring some nice anabolism, and if anything I would try running them 1:1 , test at 350 primo at 350 , and I bet you feel fucking awesome ( the hcg in there may still see e2 rising a touch higher than ideal, but you will defo feel much better than you do now )

Right let’s give you an update of where I’m at mentally haha, I want to share this stuff so people that are on the other side of the pushing drugs like I did can hopefully take something from this that’s helpful

It’s his job to be that big and that strong and to push his body ( he still does it very health consciously ) , it’s not my job to do that and for me at my height it makes my quality of life literally zero
So I’m back on track mentally , I’m not even going to take my food up in the effort to improve , I’m just going to focus on recovering from the diet ( I’m still food focused ) , so then I can diet again and this time get my weight down even lower , so I feel even better again.

thread_title: Test vs Deca vs Eq for bulking
author: Jordan Peters
content:
The sides from these drugs are so person dependant and the way eq and nandrolone interact with test is also incredibly nuanced
If you can run test , and control e2 efficiently , this imo is always the best , it’s our bio identical hormone that we KNOW for sure , the most about from a clinical perspective . So imo if you can hit your necessary mg total to improve on solely test , that’s a very good thing
You mention your own personal issues with nandrolone , so then that for YOU crosses that one off unless your happy to be a moon face lol , or you can mitigate that with caber
Eq , you need to be sure of your e2 levels and how this will interact with your a.i use , because eq will compete for aromatase and see your test convert less to e2 as eq uses up that aromatase up to convert to e1 , this can be useful in a lot of ways as means less a.i needed , but you need to be monitoring blood work to make sure you don’t bottom out your e2

thread_title: questions about cycle, npp vs deca
author: Jordan Peters
content: Npp is injected more frequently = more stable blood levels = less  sides , this is why people report a drier look as they aren’t hitting their total mg per week in 2 shots and getting the cascade of effects thereafter , nandrolone itself doesn’t aromatise much at all and specifically very little to e2 , however it can exacerbate tests estro impacts which is where people then get much more overall estro sides , so best approach – whatever ester you chose , keep injection frequency high , if using test alongside keep e2 in range – then all will be equal and it won’t matter 🙂

author: Jordan Peters
content:
Hey chaps, taking less drugs has felt like a whole new lease of life in general and I can pinpoint it to a few things – I have often ran periods of crushed e2 , that feeling was just the normal for me, cold , lacking in sympathy, zero sex drive and just totally focused on my training . That’s a bad spot to be as then how hard you can train is defo impaired as your always tired , always moody and just a shell of a person , so crushed e2 and crushed shbg is not where we want to be
My overall doses were so high that I really wonder if I was just in a toxic state in terms of digestion and then ability to even utilise drugs , I can’t say for sure but now I don’t pin much at all I have so so much more detail in places I never had when leaner , I’m much less inflamed
So I can imagine this has allowed for more fibre indeed , right now I think my fibre is probably too high and I could better help my midsection by lowering it and lowering the volume of food but I’m hungry AF , so right now I’m accepting the distention a little because I would rather than then over eat and then get fat again lol , I’m now not in a deficit so I can adjust here and get used to where I’m at , if I can’t I will have to eat a little more again , but I’m still very very lean so I’m happy to give up a little more of that to have zero food focus and simply be ready for meals at meal time and then between meals it not cross my mind until it’s meal time again , that’s important for an efficient just life I suppose , being too lean and crazy food focused is not sustainable , and everyone will have diff limits at which they can comfortably sustain, at one point I thought I could go sub 250 and sustain it but then out of no where it hit me and kicked my ass , so 255 is more realistic but then 257/258 will be much more comfy again I’m sure
Test e Vs test p , at ed injections it probably won’t matter too much, I will try test p and see how it goes, I think it will have my e2 in a slightly better spot – I will give it a few weeks after the adjustment and run E2 and test blood work to see
The novel stimulus aspect is insane tbh , I’m able to recover from SO much work, i really advise in stints people addressing their fitness , just periods of hiit and ramp it up and then let it relfeft in their training as they turn 12 rep maxes into 20s and then just step forward so much
I was SO unfit before , so for me this novel stimulus is absolutely insane hence why I have been able to hold this look and will do so all year, I know however that another diet phase I would need more anabolics if I decided to maintain what I have , and I very likely will still stick to that plan of 400 or so primo and that be it and see what the look would be going down to low 240s with that extra cosmetic buffer ontop from the primo ,.then after that back to the 250 test and back in a surplus to protect what I have . Once you have a level of muscle that you don’t want to improve on its surprised me how things can hold if you do work hard, for most people though when they stop competing they then just let their structure and regime go to shit , for me I have been able to train even harder which is why it’s worked so well , so I emplore people to drop their doses once they know they are past it, get fit , train even harder and you won’t lose a thing
I’m excited for the next 4-5 months training with a little more food and a little more rest as I’m enjoying it so much , then very excited for the next diet phase
This has actually rekindled even more love for bodybuilding in Me which is quite hilarious really , as now I don’t feel like death all the time , I’m happy , I know I’m healthier than i was and making steps to being constantly healthy , just now to see if I can fix my abs haha

author: Jordan Peters
content: The real secret to rehab is being as active as possible and it’s generally the polar opposite to advise given – the idea of rest ice compression elevation is hilarious but we have all been there . Cold therapy we have seen from any current literature to potentially be detrimental , we know anti inflammatory aids are , so all we have to do is avoid pain but look to flood things with blood daily , twice daily , three times daily . I suppose tissue work to break down adhesion is helpful but I actually think if an area is really troublesome , keeping up the blood flow even after healed is going to be the best bet , so let’s say you have a really iffy pec that’s been hurt many times, after push work the next day get your light band do 3x 20 very light flies and get the blood in there , it’s the same principle as walking / cycling the day after leg day, get blood in there and recovery will flourish

How much are you moving each day? How lean are you ? Before you get into this topic of drugging your way out of potential insulin resistance , have you considered how easy this maybe to fix through 4 steps –
Slight caloric deficit for a period of time to lower your weight by 10-12 pounds
Increase your movement across the day specifically post meals
Centre your carb intake predominantly at the workout perimeter
Increase the potential output in your sessions by adding in components that challenge you systemically – high rep deadlift sets , high rep squat sets
Something to consider before even thinking about just taking s drug to essentially mask elevated blood sugar levels

hello ?
please realise that what i am about to explain is very much RELATED TO JORDAN ONLY…. this isnt a method i use for others and not one that we use for me!.
ill try to explain as thoroughly as i can
jordan is very very sedentary – to the point where others wouldnt comprehend this! thats not an insult to jordan at all…thats a fact
So the training session is his only output. His only chance to expend energy.
Also Jordan is insanely strong – so within a session, the output is huge! as the work done is literally more. (basic maths)
Also movement during a session expends more kcals as he weighs a lot. So imagine strapping a 25kilo plate to your body and then performing your session…..much harder right! higher HR, higher breathing rate etc etc….all these elements increase energy demand and fuel used.
ANYWAY
so when jordan does a reduced session he is vastly using less calories. In comparison, If i halve my volume, YES i am doing less and using less energy, but not to the same overall extent, as my total output across a day is still demanding energy. The session as a percentage of my total output in a day is about 50%, for Jordan this would be about 95% (i dont know the % exactly obviously, im just stating numbers for reference)
changes…
i have halved his intra workout carbs, and reduced the pre and post by about 10%
i would have removed more, BUT i didnt, as we are in a deficit already, and have other tools in the mix like increased clen (another way to create a deficit) – ALSO the point of a DV period is to recover….so if i had removed MORE i feel that would have just eaten into recovery, thus negating the point!
I wanted to see jordan maintain, or step slightly forward in this phase. which he has.
Hey Jordan,
maybe it’s a dump question, but how you manage to make nearly 0 energy output during the day and is it because you don’t want to eat more?
Looking forward to your answer ?[/quote]
Because I’m working

No bloating and comfy bowel movements every morning.
This has actully been studied with similar results to mine:
https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3435786/

Hey bud, neither guys were ever taking the piss, far from it actually , they are both legit brilliant guys , I genuinely mean that too I’m not just saying that to seem like I’m keeping the peace. Once lockdown is over you will see me still socialise with joe as he lives close to me. If Tim lived close it would be the same
Ok , so obv as some of our athletes grow , their value increased and it costs us more to keep them, that was the case with basically all of them this year. So our costs increase dramatically , at that point you have to decide if then spending out on a yearly contract for others then is still worth it for the return it brings to the business . Let’s say an athlete for example is on 500quid of supps and then 500 cash a month/ they need to influence enough sales to get that 1000 back , and obv its not straight profit , our margins are small! So to level out the investment they need to make maybe 2500 worth of sales a month just to level out the investment , let alone positively influence it. Everything comes down to return on investment , so when it came to contract renewal and knowing we had to make cut backs to accommodate the increase in costs for some athletes that we know to make us the return on investment , it means some people sadly have to go . I have zero issue explaining the above to someone when it comes to their contract , often initially athletes don’t understand it because they don’t run this side of the business like I do, but I can basically look at someone’s social media profile and immediately say what I would be willing to invest in them and then what return they could bring us back . Placing well at shows , that’s not enough , looking good that’s not enough , you need to be so much more now. You need to engage , help people, inspire and motivate them, make them laugh , and a huge one for us – be a good person!

thread_title: Jordan’s 2019 Log ( NO OFF TOPIC POSTS)
author: Jordan Peters
content:
Middle peg with everything , this loads the whole range but it’s actually still really hard to lockout , failure will always come once you have got it off your chest and on the way to a lockout , so there is still some really gd overloading the short position without then having nothing in the stretch . I can’t wrap my head around loading the bottom peg and having nothing in the stretch , it just makes zero sense to me when it comes to getting big and strong . Only reason would be if your injured and your shoulders are hammered .
Next set I device the load evenly between middle and top pegs , this overloads the
Stretch a lot and just drops off nicely as you get short because you are now a little fatigued in that position
Next I load 80 percent on the top , 20 in the middle . At this point this feels insane as the load out of the stretch is really heavy but it drops off a lot to be able to squeeze
Final set I loaded everything on the top peg and just destroyed whatever my chest had left
I can’t wait to get prime overhead press machines so I can do the same . The smith is great as it’s an even strength curve so that works well , but it would be nice to have something that could then do the same on the second set of shoulder press where then load the top peg mostly so can lock things out still.
I have someone that has made me a custom pulldown , I am going to ask him to make me a custom tricep press machine also , because same reason, tbe smith is amazing as it’s an even curve, but something that dropped off at that point to lockout is ideal. Again I do not understand AT ALL banding or using chains at this point in a session , it’s 6th set of presses , your triceps are fucked in the lockout , but still have some oomph in the stretch . I actually think the kit game is about to change , the two pieces that I will have custom made are game changers and it won’t take long for people that understand kit to follow suit . 10 years from now, not a single person will want hammer strength upper body kit, I have called it now

Rest day, feeling good , adductor is sore but I will keep kwang loonging it and it should be cool for next session.
Check in day for us is a write off for us . So here is something interesting to share , we had a custom client system built a long time ago to manage client numbers , imo it’s just not possible to effectively manage clients using just email , while saving all their check ins, check in pics , payment due dates , there is so much info that really needs auto saving, so then each client has a huge cache of data , for example I have clients for 5-6 years and my system has every single check in they have ever done saved, every change made at those check ins , and every message ever sent in a long chat history like Facebook chat. This imo is a total game changer to saving time and being efficient , it also means your email doesn’t get jammed up which can be solely for admin , taking on new work and whatever else you use email for. Mark Fox , our web guy , has built a new system which we are about to transition over which is even more efficient again , as it has built in systems to take payment , save and share documents , it even has a full built in food database and exercise data base , but also the ability to link your own personal exercise database if you have one , or you can use the one he has built . It’s incredible tbh so that will make check in days even more Efficient . I think genuinely all coaches should be using a system like this , regardless of numbers , because even for something like taking payment , and your client knowing exactly when they are due to pay and them getting an automated invoice , it then means you won’t miss payments which I know without a doubt tons of coaches do , when they can’t keep up because they are bogged down in emails or what’s app

Another perfect leg session , more all time pbs.
Someone asked me today when did I last have a run of bad sessions ? And genuinely the answer is never , I don’t even have one bad session – I have sometimes one set where I get 1 rep less than I wanted but even that is very very rare , even when totally injured and couldn’t train upper , I still had absolutely perfect lower body sessions every other day . They then asked me how that’s possible ? And again the answer is super simple , control every variable that can be controlled . I never miss meals ever , I never over or under eat , I never eat off plan , if I want a sushi meal, it’s factored into my macros and becomes a constant, I never go to bed late, I don’t let people into my life that cause stress. Personally i think those things are really simple, and if you want to build muscle and get strong , just put those things into place and crack on . Anyways , I thought I would share that , as I found it interesting how confused the person who asked me seemed to be, by the simple idea of controlling a few variables. And the thing is , if you can’t do the above that’s totally cool, just stop vocalising that you want a goal. If the words “ I want to achieve X “ , come out of your mouth , don’t do things that contradict that goal .
